messages:
Emma: noticing a cluster-wide uptick in tiny-gpu pod pending in us-west2c, started ~10:12. lots of preemptions and attach failures. anyone else seeing this?
Jon: saw alerts, looks like a wave of evictions from rack-23 nodes. eviction rate jumped ~3x.
Linh: I captured scheduler events — many pods failing to bind due to 'InsufficientGPU' even though node GPU usage is low. suspect fragmentation.
Emma: exact msg: `failed to reserve slot: not enough contiguous gpu slots` on several evictions.
Priya: that wording matches the fractional-gang change we rolled last week. could be the new slot-coalescer heuristics failing for tiny pods.
Marco: also saw attach/detach churn in kubelet logs: repeated detach for the same GPU device id, e.g. `nvmlDetachError: -999` then reattach. drives resync backoff.
Jon: OpsBot reported a topology change earlier: `rack-23-switch-flap detected, 3 ports transient` around 10:05 — might correlate with nic timeouts causing latebinds.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: noticed canary placement policy rollout at 09:58 (scheduler config bump `coalesce_threshold=0.4`).
Linh: timeline looks like: config rollout -> switch flap -> nvlink attach jitter -> scheduler starts orphaning small pods waiting for contiguous slots -> backoff -> eviction ripple.
Emma: workaround? rolling back the coalesce flag or relaxing contiguous requirement might help.
Priya: rolling back coalesce sounds risky for throughput, but temporary disable for us-west2 would be fine.
Jon: we could also force a descheduler run or trigger warm-pool refill to create compact placement islands.
Marco: warming will take 12-15m. rollback is faster.
Linh: quick check: `kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME,GPU_FREE:status.allocatable.gpu` shows some nodes with partial free slots but fragmented. attaching snippet:
```
node-rack23-11   2
node-rack23-12   0
node-rack23-13   1
node-rack23-14   3
```
But the scheduler wants 2 contiguous slots for some tiny gang requests due to fractional gang policy.
Emma: I'm going to open a rollback PR for the coalesce flag to previous value and patch the canary selector so only us-west2 gets it off.
Priya: +1. Also add a temporary probe to descheduler to consolidate tiny pods after rollback.
Jon: I'll keep watch on attach/detach errors and NVML logs. If switch flaps persist we may need infra to shift traffic away from rack-23.
Marco: FYI the attach/detach errors include this stack: `kubelet: device-plugin: failed to allocate device gpu-0: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = device busy`. Might be a kernel driver edge case exposed by the switch-induced i/o stalls.
OpsBot: incident: created incident INC-2026-3092, severity=low, owner=@Jon.
Linh: I'll instrument scheduler decision traces for the next hour (`/debug/scheduler/trace`) so we can see why it's refusing fragmented slots.
Emma: plan agreed: rollback coalesce on us-west2, trigger warm-pool refill, run descheduler consolidation, monitor for 30m. if attach/detach errors continue, escalate to infra.
Priya: added a note to the config rollback PR to revert when packing telemetry stabilizes.
Jon: rolling back now to canary group us-west2 only. status: patch applied 10:26.
Marco: seeing fewer new evictions at 10:30. attach errors still occasional but lower volume.
Emma: thanks team. followup: postmortem if this recurs or if rollback causes perf regressions. :thumbsup:
Priya: logging next steps in runbook: add transient-network-probe before slot-coalescer ramp in future rollouts.
Jon: closing loop, will update INC-2026-3092 with metrics and timeline.
